title: FAIRGAME: a Framework for AI Agents Bias Recognition using Game Theory

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating identical game-theoretic scenarios (e.g., Prisoner's Dilemma, Battle of the Sexes) translated into five different languages (English, French, Arabic, Vietnamese, Mandarin Chinese) and measuring the cross-language inconsistency in the agents' strategic decisions and outcomes.

Assigning predefined personality traits (e.g., 'cooperative', 'selfish') or distinct historical identities (e.g., Adolf Hitler, Mahatma Gandhi) to AI agents and observing how these assigned personas alter their cooperation or defection rates in multi-agent game-theoretic interactions.
